purpose: Validate reference learning on full-information-state Leduc, then diagnose frozen six-player policies against independent behavioral baselines
limitations: Leduc is a two-player reduced poker game; reference learning does not establish six-player poker strength
Small CPU budget and explicit legal-policy normalization differ from a full paper reproduction
Reference opponents are fixed transparent heuristics, not validated strong poker agents
Six-player diagnostic comparisons do not replace the original four performance conditions
No original self-play extension, candidate promotion, or automatic retrial
